description.value: Aura Natural Market is a natural and organic health foods store in Langley, BC, stocking a broad range of fresh produce, meats, dairy, baked goods, and pantry staples alongside a deep selection of vitamins, supplements, and natural personal care products. The store also operates a juice and smoothie counter and offers on-site Registered Holistic Nutritionist (RHN) consultations, making it a more comprehensive wellness destination than a typical grocery stop. Touring cyclists will find it a solid resupply point for whole foods, snacks, and natural energy products.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: bollard (4 spaces) at 11m; bollard (4 spaces) at 42m; bollard (6 spaces) at 53m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Aura Natural Market is an active natural health food store with a full e-commerce presence. Product categories on the site include Fresh Fruit, Fresh Vegetables, Fresh Meats, Dairy, Eggs, and Bread, confirming basic groceries are sold. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cyclist-specific infrastructure was found anywhere in the website content. The contact page title references 'Surrey & Langley,' consistent with the OSM Langley location, though a second (Surrey) location may also exist.
concerns: The contact page title reads 'Aura Natural Market in Surrey & Langley,' suggesting a second location in Surrey may exist. The OSM record covers only the Langley location (8045 204 Street, Unit D120); the Surrey location, if real, would be a separate OSM record.
Phone number and street address could not be cross-confirmed from the website content due to truncation of the contact page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active natural grocery and health food store in Langley with a functional website and confirmed product offerings; a useful resupply stop for touring cyclists.
